purpose: Every standalone Towns & Towers mushroom-fields fantasy piece and the complete CTOV mushroom village, with mine and well donors, for selecting the Mushroom catalog.
worldNote: Placed in the trio test world east of the Savanna gallery, with the void biome filled through every row's sky so lightning cannot strike.
selectionRule: Every standalone piece of the T&T mushroom-fields fantasy village and its outpost tower, entity-only animal templates omitted; every standalone CTOV mushroom piece, roads omitted and entities stripped, with other mods' blocks shown as the vanilla blocks in standInSwaps; the ten original Village Life mines and the D&T miner compound; the D&T, Terralith and T&T classic wells. Street, terminator and villager templates are omitted.

biome.reason: no precipitation at any height, so no lightning on the mushroom blocks; ordinary green grass

standInSwaps.rule: A block from another mod becomes the vanilla block its exact id names, keeping every same-named block property the vanilla block defines; an unlisted block of a listed mod becomes that mod's default; anything else follows the Tundra keyword rules and ends as chiseled stone bricks.

licensing: CTOV and Towns & Towers are CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 and Dungeons & Taverns is under its own licence: their display copies stay private under run/, as for every gallery. See docs/structure-sourcing.md.

studies.rule: MU13: each T&T mushroom gazebo composed with one of its profession inserts at the jigsaw offset (2, 1, 2), unrotated, by run/full-style-showcase/RamshackleComposite.java; the inserts alone stand in MU02. MU14 to MU17: the bundled Birch market tiers and wall family from main with the family's materials (stems, oak, orange concrete, mushroom caps, cobbled deepslate and smooth basalt); trade colours, torches, ladders and the gatehouse campfire and banners untouched.

selection.coordinates: Positions are template-local [x, y, z] from each exhibit's gallery origin, to be read from the saved world after Aaron's edits (a mushroom survey.py modelled on run/savanna-full-profile/survey.py).
selection.direction: Towns & Towers mushroom-fields fantasy family as the base: every pick so far is from MU01 and MU02. The CTOV rows stand for comparison; the mine and well donor rows are reserves for roles the family lacks.

identity.beds: Some combination of the primary and secondary colour; a couple's double bed is one colour on both halves.
identity.banners: Every banner is the village's banner.
identity.note: Aaron, 2026-09-14 late evening. The family's fixed accents are orange concrete, cyan carpet at the centre, and the red or brown mushroom caps.

selected.label: T&T mushroom meeting point 1
selected.note: Aaron: a little bell and a campfire (the campfire is his addition; the template has none). Upstairs a bed for a cleric with one chest for personal storage and one for the cleric station (brewing stand). The cleric is an extra centre job at founding, the Mediterranean precedent (EXTRA_CENTER_JOBS in BadlandsVillageVerification). The template holds one bed, so the founding beds come from starting_buildings houses as Mediterranean and Rustic do.

selected.label: T&T mushroom large house 1
selected.note: Two beds and a shared chest on the loft under the cap. Aaron wants to see the villagers climb its spiral staircase: in the template it is a half-block ramp of slabs around the stem (bottom, double, top slab per quarter turn), so each cell rises half a block and only the last step onto the loft floor is a full block. Confirm with the access harness in the close-out.

selected.label: T&T mushroom large house 2
selected.note: Aaron: a one-bed house. The template carries a magenta and an orange bed; read his edit from the world.

selected.label: T&T light professions gazebo
selected.note: The mine. The shaft goes down on the side where Aaron set a barrel; the barrel is the mine's container. Mouth at station + mine_entrance offset, the miner's post two cells behind the mouth (Polynesian pattern), the ramp descending away from the gazebo.

selected.label: T&T mushroom small house 1
selected.note: Aaron: the couple's bed. The template holds one green bed on the upper floor; a couple room needs two adjacent beds, so read his edit from the world.

selected.label: T&T mushroom small house 2
selected.note: Four barrels in it (Aaron's edit; the template has a blue bed and no barrels). Quartermaster station inside.

selected.label: T&T mushroom butcher 1
selected.note: Aaron first skipped it ('might make that a butchery or a bakery'), then: 'let's make MU02.1 a bakery'. It has a smoker and a chest.

selected.label: T&T mushroom leatherworker 1
selected.note: The fenced pen with two gates, a cauldron and a chest. Aaron: inside there should be mushrooms, put up four; read as four mooshrooms in the pen (mooshrooms extend Cow, so FarmedStock already treats them as cows). Confirm the count and kind with him.

selected.label: T&T mushroom small farm 1
selected.note: Aaron rebuilt it as a normal crop farm: the crops are farmed on the piece itself, no mushroom farming code for now (2026-09-14). Read his beds and crops from the world.

selected.label: T&T heavy gazebo + armorer insert
selected.note: Aaron: 'the blacksmith with their chest'. Blast furnace station, the insert's chest is the smith's container.

selected.label: T&T heavy gazebo + mason insert
selected.note: Stonecutter station with the insert's chest.

selected.label: T&T light gazebo + fisher insert
selected.note: Aaron: 'the barrel and everything'. Two barrels; needs adjacent water at placement.

selected.label: T&T light gazebo + fletcher insert
selected.note: Fletching table station with the insert's chest; wild mooshrooms are the island's game.

selected.label: Market tiers 1 to 3 (the Birch geometry in oak, mushroom-stem posts, orange concrete paving)
selected.note: Aaron: 'the markets look good'. Used from the prepared study copies; trade colours untouched.

selected.label: Wall B: red and brown mushroom caps on a mushroom-stem footing, oak fence tips, oak slab walks
selected.note: Aaron: 'wall B is a vibe'. Bundled into the code as the mushroom wall family from the study files.

selected.label: Lumberjack: the light professions gazebo (unedited prepared copy) with an oak sapling stand three blocks west and a barrel inside
selected.note: Not a pick of Aaron's: he left the lumberjack open ('I don't even know what a lumberjack would look like here'). The island has no trees, and the planner's own rule is that a village with no way to make logs is stuck until it raises a lumberjack, so the catalog carries one in the family's own gazebo with an oak sapling, the family's timber. Swap or drop it at will.

selection.galleryNote: MU03 to MU10 were re-placed on 2026-09-14 evening with per-block vanilla stand-ins for the CTOV pieces' other-mod blocks (manifest standInSwaps), after Aaron found the uniform chiseled-stone markers read as nothing. MU13 (placed 2026-09-14 late evening, run/mushroom-full-profile/workshop.py) shows each gazebo composed with each of its profession inserts, since MU02.4 to MU02.11 alone read to Aaron as pieces with nothing around them. MU14 to MU17 (same evening, workshop.py palette studies) show the market tiers and three wall options in the family's materials.

omitted.church: Aaron: 'we don't need a church, technically our town center is one' (the cleric lives at MU01.1).
